name: Nanopore_Sequencing_Benchmark_Dataset
description: A dataset of nanopore sequencing reads and associated labels intended to benchmark signal-to-sequence models (basecallers) and other downstream sequence-analysis methods. It measures how well models convert raw nanopore current signal into accurate nucleotide sequences and supports evaluation of read-level and base-level accuracy. Typical uses include basecalling, signal preprocessing, and alignment/variant-detection benchmarking.
evaluation_method: edit_distance (base error rate) and base-level accuracy
general_score_metric: base-level accuracy (and edit distance/read error rate)
reputation: Specialized dataset hosted on Hugging Face with moderate adoption among nanopore/basecalling researchers and tool developers.
